revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Yes. The Kappa is clearly raised and there is nothing to indicate the intention of a Lambda.
Submit - Ἡρακ(λείδην) instead of Ἡρακλ(είδην) in l.1
Commit - Ἡρακ(λείδην) instead of Ἡρακλ(είδην) in l.1
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - AcceptText - Readings for lines 1, 4 and 7 seem fine, as is removal of |alt|. As Cowey states, separate files for 5.333 and 5.334 are needed.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with the readings in lin1, 4 and 7. In lin1 the removal of the alt reading is fine. These two versions of the same text P.Mich. V 333 and 334 should be published in full separately.

line 1: κατε(χωρίσθη) → κατεχ(ωρίσθη) based on digital image (Michigan APIS): the chi is present, written suprascript, so by convention (as elsewhere in the ed. pr. too) this seems a better resolution. In line 1 there seems also to be a data entry error: there has been an effort to represent the fact that, as ed. pr. notes, line 1 is lacking in the duplicate, P.Mich. V 334, but I don't think |alt| is the right way to encode this (the app.cr. should simply reads 'line 1 omitted in the duplicate' vel sim.). I have removed the |alt| encoding for now line 4: Πολέμονος → Πολέμωνος based on digital image: the omega seems clear line 7: δακτύλ(ῳ) → δακτύλοͅ (l. δακτύλῳ) based on digital image: the word does not seem to be abbreviated, though the alpha, tau, and upsilon are quite compressed, all are present on the main line; there is no suprascript letter or other stroke to indicate an abbreviation, and it seems preferable to see a simple phonetic error here line 20: entered BL correction
